title: NeoSwitch — Keep Claude Code. Switch your models.
description: NeoSwitch runs a small local proxy so Claude Code can use Gemini 4 Neon while keeping its commands, permissions, tools, MCP servers and hooks.
og_description: Switch individual Claude Code sessions to Gemini 4 Neon through a local TLS proxy. One session at a time, loopback only, open source.
og_image_alt: NeoSwitch: Keep Claude Code. Switch your models. Claude Code to a 127.0.0.1 proxy to Gemini 4 Neon.
jsonld_description: A Claude Code plugin and local Anthropic-compatible proxy that lets Claude Code use Gemini 4 Neon while keeping its commands, permissions, tools, MCP servers and hooks.
hero_lede: NeoSwitch lets you switch individual Claude Code sessions to Gemini 4 Neon in place. Your commands, connectors, Auto Mode, permissions, tools, skills, MCP servers, hooks and other windows stay exactly as they are.
how_sub: Claude Code still owns the session, permissions, tool execution and CLAUDE.md. NeoSwitch sits on loopback and speaks the Anthropic Messages API on one side and Gemini on the other.
node_client_desc: Same CLI, slash commands, claude.ai connectors, Auto Mode, skills, MCP servers, hooks and /resume.
node_proxy_desc: Local TLS Anthropic-compatible endpoint (discarded CA key). Per-session routing, no prompt or credential logging, no remote relay.
node_upstream_desc: Through the official genai SDK, or the unmodified local agy acp process.
why_sub: A model switch for people who already like how Claude Code works.
why_workflow_desc: Keep claude.ai connectors, Auto Mode, WebSearch and instant zero-turn commands. Nothing to relearn or migrate.
why_project_desc: Switch a single session on or off in place from its next message; other windows in the same project stay on Claude.
why_local_desc: Local TLS only. OAuth tokens stay inside agy, its own file and shell tools are blocked, and your CA/headers are restored on off.
why_honest_desc: Live 5-hour and weekly quota bars in /neoswitch:status, long-session ACP reuse with a slim agent, and no silent fallback.
cmp_sub: A native plugin built for keeping your normal Claude Code setup, rather than replacing it with a separate desktop app or global proxy.
cmp_th_managers_ex: e.g. CC Switch, Claude Code Router
cmp_setup_ns: Native Claude Code plugin — no desktop app or server to manage
cmp_setup_mgr: Separate desktop app managing configs across many CLIs
cmp_setup_prx: Standalone Node.js proxy server + Web UI
cmp_scope_ns: One session at a time (/neoswitch:on, /neoswitch:off); other windows stay on Claude
cmp_scope_mgr: Global provider switching or shared local router
cmp_features_ns: Kept intact — no ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN set, so claude.ai connectors, WebSearch, Auto Mode, live quota and native mod commands keep working
cmp_features_mgr: Managed through external config or router
cmp_signin_ns: Uses your Google account through official agy — never reads, stores, or replays OAuth tokens; agy's own tools are blocked
cmp_signin_mgr: Primarily API keys and third-party relays (no agy integration)
cmp_signin_prx: Stores or reads local OAuth tokens to call private endpoints directly
cmp_best_ns: Keeping your normal Claude Code setup and switching individual sessions to Gemini 4 Neon
cmp_best_mgr: Managing many CLIs, API keys, relays, and MCPs in one place
cmp_best_prx: Multi-account rotation, Windows, or running Claude models via Antigravity
start_sub: Requires Claude Code on macOS or Linux (Windows not supported yet). Go is optional: the plugin builds from source or downloads the checksum-verified release binary. For Antigravity OAuth, /neoswitch:login installs Google's official agy CLI when missing.
step2_title: Sign in and switch this session on
step2_desc: In the project you want to switch (supports browser and remote/SSH code sign-in). To use a Gemini API key instead, export GEMINI_API_KEY and run /neoswitch:on.
step3_title: Send your next message — no restart
step3_desc: This session switches to Gemini 4 Neon from its next message while other windows stay on Claude. On Claude Code 2.1.326+, a status line under the prompt shows the active model and /neoswitch:status shows live quota with zero turn spent.
cred_sub: Run neoswitch doctor on any path. It looks the model up, runs a one-line generation and names the failing step if something is wrong.
cred_oauth_signin: Google account through the official agy CLI
cred_oauth_notes: The plugin's default flow. Read the warning below first.
cred_api_notes: Access to Gemini 4 Neon depends on your key.
cred_vertex_notes: Access depends on your project and region.
warn_body: The Google Antigravity Terms of Service (section 6) treat accessing Antigravity through third-party software as a breach, and Google may suspend or terminate the Antigravity accounts involved. Routing Claude Code through Antigravity OAuth falls under that rule. Use it only if you accept that risk for the account you sign in with; otherwise use a Gemini API key or Vertex AI.
compat_sub: An automated end-to-end suite runs the real Claude Code CLI through NeoSwitch on every change; how well a real model follows Claude Code's tool protocol is exercised in everyday coding use.
tools_acp: JSON envelope (parallel calls + escape repair); calls arrive whole, not streamed
effort_api: Sent as Gemini's thinking level (also maps thinking.budget_tokens)
tokens_api: Reported; estimated on the Developer API
tokens_acp: Reported, incl. <1k tokens of slim neoswitch agent overhead
compat_note: Not supported on either path: server tools such as code execution, URL image and document sources, and replaying Claude's signed thinking blocks in history. Full contract in docs/protocol-contract.md.
cmds_sub: Changes apply to this session from its next message, with no restart. On Claude Code 2.1.326+, all four commands run locally without a model turn.
cmd_login: Sign in via official agy (browser or SSH code), switch Google accounts, and turn this session on
cmd_on: Switch this session to Gemini 4 Neon from its next message
cmd_status: Show active model, Google sign-in, and 5-hour/weekly quota bars (-v adds all groups, credits and details)
cmd_off: Switch this session back to Claude from its next message
cmds_note: The plugin supports macOS and Linux. Prefer a standalone binary? Builds for macOS, Linux and Windows are on the Releases page, and neoswitch serve works with any Anthropic-compatible client.
